Public holidays

The gallery is closed on the following German public holidays in 2026:

  • 1 January — Neujahr
  • 3 April — Karfreitag
  • 6 April — Ostermontag
  • 1 May — Tag der Arbeit
  • 14 May — Christi Himmelfahrt
  • 25 May — Pfingstmontag
  • 3 October — Tag der Deutschen Einheit
  • 24 December – 4 January 2027 — Winter closure

Getting here

S-Bahn — Oranienburger Straße (S1, S2, S25, S26), 4 minutes' walk.
U-Bahn — Weinmeisterstraße (U8) or Oranienburger Tor (U6), 7 minutes' walk.
Tram — M1 and M5 stop Weinmeisterstraße/Gipsstraße.
Bus — 142 (Auguststraße) stops directly in front of the gallery.
Bicycle — Bicycle racks at Auguststraße/Tucholskystraße corner.
Parking — Limited paid street parking. Public car park at Hackescher Markt, 6 minutes' walk.

Accessibility

The Hauptraum and Saal on the ground floor are fully wheelchair-accessible via the main entrance. An accessible WC is located on the ground floor.

An elevator connects the ground floor and the gallery office, but the basement Project Room is currently accessible only via stairs. We are working on a long-term solution; in the meantime, please contact the gallery to arrange a private viewing of any Project Room work.

Hearing loop available on request. Service animals welcome. Large-print exhibition texts in German and English are available at the front desk.

Photography policy

Personal photography is permitted in all exhibitions without flash and without tripods. Please be mindful of other visitors and of any photography restrictions specifically noted at the entrance to an exhibition.

Commercial photography, filming for any media use, and the use of drones inside or outside the gallery require prior written permission from the press office.

Press images are available to credentialed journalists via press.betongalerie.de with login.

Gallery rules

  • Please leave large bags and umbrellas in the cloakroom.
  • Food and drink are not permitted in the exhibition rooms.
  • Do not touch works unless explicitly indicated by gallery staff.
  • Sketching with pencil is welcome; pens and markers are not permitted in the exhibition rooms.
  • Children are welcome; please keep them in your direct supervision.
  • The gallery reserves the right to refuse entry.

Group visits

Free · By appointment

Beton Galerie welcomes guided visits for university seminars, professional groups, and collector circles. Tours are led by a member of the curatorial team and last approximately 45 minutes. Groups are limited to 18 people. Please request a booking at least two weeks in advance.

Schulprogramme

School programs & workshops

Beton Galerie runs a small Schulprogramm for Berlin secondary schools and university art-history seminars, free of charge. The program is led by Lena Brückner with a rotating group of represented artists, and is offered in German and English. Workshop slots are limited to one per academic month; advance booking is essential. Please write to education@betongalerie.de with the year-group, subject focus, and three possible dates.

Beton Galerie

Auguststraße 47, 10117 Berlin-Mitte. Founded 2011 by Anneliese Vogel and Karim Behzadi. Representing twelve international artists working in sculpture, installation, video, painting, and performance.
